Author: dajoey
Name: Gluttony Combo
Punchline: Lalalazy fork of Wrath Combo - XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Description: Gluttony Combo is a lalalazy-branded fork of Wrath Combo. Condenses combos and mutually exclusive abilities onto a single button - and then some. All upstream credit to Team Wrath / PunishXIV.
Changelog:
v1.0.4.84 - Synced upstream Wrath Combo: DNC opener/prepull tuning, NIN & opener skip fixes
- Dancer: reworked opener and prepull timings - prepull delays are now float-based for tighter accuracy, countdown handling updated, and a bug where the opener skipped the potion when it was on cooldown is fixed.
- Ninja: mudra anti-rabbit detection now resolves the queued/replaced action via the game's adjusted-action lookup (more reliable).
- Auto-rotation openers: better handling of back-to-back skipped steps, plus extra skip safety so the opener stays in sync.
- Minor Machinist, Red Mage and Samurai rotation refinements from upstream.
- All GluttonyCombo customizations preserved: Amnesia / Pacification / Silence handling, Pyretic / Reflect penalties, 15s raidwide-mitigation gate, WHM ground-heal targeting, SMN Aegis Uptime, BattleData, BLU engine.
